scope: Independent source and run-009 receipt review only; no browser, test, build, or implementation edit.

findings: The probe waits for a settled Mine inventory, rejects a Vault error or missing Shared tab, and requires a selected device organization before checking notices. When the picker appears, selection uses the exact approved option through the driver's stable, hit-tested CDP mouse path; beforeOrganizationChoice and afterOrganizationChoice observations remain intact.

Dismissal requires exactly one role=alert with the source Capture list unavailable title and the db-failure no-workspace sentence in its first message paragraph. The driver selects only that alert's Dismiss button, verifies a unique visible hit-tested target, sends a trusted mouse press/release, then waits until the matching alert count is zero before recording dismissedStaleCaptureNoWorkspaceNotice=true.

Other alerts do not match the selector and are not dismissed. A second matching alert fails as ambiguous. The driver still refuses a Shared click covered by any remaining alert; known_notice reports a bounded category on that failure without returning arbitrary notice text.

The matched sentence is a distinctive fixed source fragment, not a full-message equality check. Current source has one Capture list unavailable title and one no-workspace message template, so this identifies that known source case; the title and message checks occur independently inside the page realm.

runtime.evidence: Run 009 proves a NoticeHost-shaped role=alert card covered all nine Shared-tab interior points after real organization selection. It did not record the alert title or message, so it does not prove the occluder is the Capture no-workspace notice. The changed probe has no subsequent run receipt in this review.

If another alert remains, preserve its bounded known_notice category and investigate the actual product error. Member authorization remains separately unverified.
